## What is 10MS Course Shop?
10MS Course Shop (https://10mscourse.shop) aggregates 10 Minute School's official courses across all academic and skill categories:
1. Academic: Class 6, Class 7, Class 8 (বৃত্তি ও বার্ষিক পরীক্ষা প্রস্তুতি)
2. SSC: SSC 2026, SSC 2027 Online Batch & Crash Courses
3. HSC: HSC 2026, HSC 2027, HSC 2028 (Science, Humanities, Business Studies, Bangla, English, ICT)
4. University Admission: Medical, Engineering (BUET), University A/B/C Unit Preparation
5. Language & Skills: "Ghore Boshe Spoken English" by Munzereen Shahid, IELTS Live Batch, Kids English, Spoken English Junior
6. Career & Freelancing: BCS Preparation, Bank Job, Digital Marketing, Web Development, Graphic Design

## How It Works
1. Students browse course reviews, outlines, syllabus, and discount expiration dates on https://10mscourse.shop
2. Clicking "কিনুন" (Buy Now) or clicking any course card directs the student to the official 10 Minute School checkout with the affiliate promo discount code pre-applied.
3. Students complete payment securely via bKash, Nagad, Rocket, or card on the official 10 Minute School platform.
